decisions.statement: APP_ORIGIN follows the native shell to the https origin of the site.
A recorded session whose base and udid match is reused where the recorded session still answers.
The auth session is written into localStorage before the route is assigned.
A throw from window.location.assign is swallowed.
The webview context is acquired a second time after the route is assigned.
Each thing an opening did is named as soon as that thing is done.
An opening that threw part way leaves those names for its caller to refuse with.
A session reused is named by nothing, since that session was already there.
The loading, the opening, the signing in, the scripting and the saving are handed in.
Attaching to a webview names the context it switched the session onto.
Driving the session already there is attaching to the webview of the session written down.

definition: opening an appium session on the sim and landing its webview on an app route
